description: Migrate both Release 1244 schema-3 state and the earlier qualified Release 1245 schema-4 state into the current schema without erasing witnessed history

replacements.old:
<COND (<EQUAL? <GET ,MARA-STATE 0> ,MARA-PREVIOUS-SCHEMA>
           ;"Release 1243 saves keep every witnessed event. Only the new
             House-company fields begin empty."
           <PUT ,MARA-STATE 0 ,MARA-SCHEMA>
           ;"Release 1245 saves retain all existing Mara history. Only the
             newly introduced death-witness and offscreen-comedy fields begin empty."
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-DEATH-WITNESSED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-OFFSCREEN-GAG 0>)
          (<NOT <EQUAL? <GET ,MARA-STATE 0> ,MARA-SCHEMA>>
           <MARA-RESET-STATE>)>
replacements.new:
<COND (<EQUAL? <GET ,MARA-STATE 0> 3>
           ;"Release 1244 saves retain every witnessed House and Dam event; all Release 1245-only history begins empty."
           <PUT ,MARA-STATE 0 ,MARA-SCHEMA>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-RESTRAINT-ATTEMPTED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-COMBAT-ORDER-ATTEMPTED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-BOUND-TROLL-WITNESSED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-DEATH-WITNESSED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-OFFSCREEN-GAG 0>)
          (<EQUAL? <GET ,MARA-STATE 0> ,MARA-PREVIOUS-SCHEMA>
           ;"Earlier qualified Release 1245 saves retain restraint, combat-order, and bound-troll history; only the new fields begin empty."
           <PUT ,MARA-STATE 0 ,MARA-SCHEMA>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-DEATH-WITNESSED 0>
           <MARA-PUT ,MARA-SLOT-OFFSCREEN-GAG 0>)
          (<NOT <EQUAL? <GET ,MARA-STATE 0> ,MARA-SCHEMA>>
           <MARA-RESET-STATE>)>
